flows.title: Start a project
steps: Hover over the left side of your account and click Projects, or go straight to claude.ai/projects.
Click + New Project in the upper right corner.
Give the project a name and a description. Claude does not read either of them.
On a Team or Enterprise plan, choose whether to keep it private to you and the members you invite, or share it with your broader organization where administrators allow that.
With the project set up, start chats with Claude inside it.

flows.title: Give a project knowledge and instructions
steps: Open the project. Its knowledge base is on the right side of the project's main page, and what sits there is used across every chat in that project.
Click the + button and upload the documents, text files or code snippets the project should know about.
Click Set project instructions, write how Claude should behave and respond, and click Save instructions.
Context does not travel between chats in a project unless it is in the project knowledge base.

flows.title: Share a chat, and stop sharing it
steps: Click the Share button in the upper right corner of the chat.

Click Share in the pop-out to make a link. Anyone with it can then read a snapshot of every message sent before that moment, artifacts included; messages sent afterwards stay private until the chat is unshared and shared again.
To stop sharing, open the Share menu, click the visibility dropdown and change the chat from Public to Private.
On a free, Pro or Max plan, Settings then Privacy then Manage next to Shared chats lists every shared snapshot, with an Unshare button beside each one.
